newsitem.title: USA: RCSB Financial up sharply on merger news.
newsitem.headline: RCSB Financial up sharply on merger news.

text.p: RCSB Financial Inc was up seven to 41 in early trading Thursday after last night's announcement it will be acquired by Charter One Financial Inc in a $635 million stock transaction.

"On the surface it looks like a pretty fair valuation," said Frank Barkocy, analyst at Josephthal, Lyon & Ross. He said Charter One, based in Cleveland, was paying about two times book value and 16 times trailing 12-month earnings for the Rochester, N.Y.-based thrift.
RCSB shareholders will receive 0.91 Charter One share for each RCSB share.
Charter One was off 1/8 to 46-5/8. RCSB holders would get $42.43 for each RCSB share based on the Charter One stock price Thursday.
Barkocy said there has been a large amount of bank and thrift consolidation in both upstate and downstate New York, a trend which he expects to continue.

Analyst Kevin Timmons of First Albany Co Thursday started research coverage of Charter One with a buy rating. He said the company has the ability to grow earnings internally by 10 to 11 percent year, but with management's proven record in acquisitions earnings growth can be at least 12 percent a year.
